## 5. Liability
Each party's aggregate liability is limited to EUR 2,000,000.00, except for wilful misconduct, gross negligence and injury to life, body or health.

## 3. Term and renewal
This agreement runs from 2026-01-01 until 2026-12-31 and renews automatically for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives notice at least 14 days before the end of the then-current term.

## 6. Data protection
Kestrelbyte acts as processor under Article 28 GDPR. Kestrelbyte shall not engage any sub-processors.

## 4. Service levels
Monthly availability target 99.5 %. Service credits of up to 40 % of the monthly fee apply for missed availability.

## 8. Governing law and venue
This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York; courts in New York have jurisdiction.

## 5. Breach notification
Kestrelbyte notifies the Customer of a personal data breach within 12 hours of becoming aware.

## 7. Confidentiality
Both parties keep confidential information secret during the term and for three years after.

## 8. Governing law and venue
German law; the courts of Berlin have exclusive jurisdiction.
